notes: V1 stores Standard short-context input and output prices plus Batch short-context input and output prices. GPT-5.5 Pro does not offer a cached-input discount, so cached_input is null rather than zero. Long-context Standard pricing is $60 input and $270 output per 1M tokens; Batch pricing is $30 input and $135 output per 1M tokens.
